title: A completed hosted loss, not a stalled game
scope: ACTUAL_HOSTED_PUBLIC_REPLAY; own farm/callback logs and public opponent farm only.
coordinate_rule: tiles[y][x]; positions[x,y]; y down; both boards retain original orientation
action_alignment: Incoming recorded command produces the displayed saved row; request fills are not asserted.
privacy: No rival private inventory, seeds, configuration or unobserved future state rendered/exported.
trace_rule: Only observed historical balances through current row; display uses step segments between saved samples.
hand_marker_rule: Each exact public hand position contributes to a per-cell count; F marks exact farmer cell.

observed_checks: Current grids, public worker markers and bank values match selected saved states
Zero-based day/hour and saved-row labels retained
Terminal own/rival arithmetic and outcome correct
No decoded-frame corruption or blocking text overlap found
visual_review.limit: Agent inspection of12decoded stills plus full-frame technical decode; not human full-motion acceptance.

metadata_correction.reason: Milestone animal summaries were corrected from tile animal fields; rendering already read the raw replay and was unaffected. Original case-input bytes retained.
